name: Segger J-Link
description: Installs the Segger J-Link Linux package (JLinkExe, JLinkGDBServer, JLinkRTTClient, …) and its X11/xcb/xkbcommon runtime dependencies. Used by `west flash -r jlink`, Cortex-Debug, and any IDE that drives a Segger J-Link / J-Trace probe. Downloads the .deb from segger.com at image build time using the standard CLI license-accept POST.

version.description: J-Link version. 'latest' downloads the current package from segger.com (JLink_Linux_<arch>.deb). Otherwise pass a Segger version string like 'V844a' which is interpolated into the archived URL JLink_Linux_<version>_<arch>.deb (see https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/ for the list of archived versions). Pin a specific version for reproducible images.
